qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Despite T-Mobile US's 5G mid-band spectrum leadership and German fixed broadband dominance, 4-year median GAAP ROIC is 11.57% (failing 12%). T-Mobile's foundational 'Price-Lock' guarantee and German regulatory wholesale price caps prevent pricing power >= inflation across full business cycles.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12% & lacks above-inflation pricing power, REJECT). Deutsche Telekom is an exceptional transatlantic telecom operator driven by T-Mobile US, but 4-year median GAAP ROIC of 11.57% falls short of the 12% hurdle. T-Mobile's Price-Lock marketing guarantee and German regulatory rate constraints prevent above-inflation pricing, while €96B in debt violates fortress standards.
qualitative.evidence: Reported GAAP ROIC averaged 11.57% across 2022–2025 (10.05% in 2022, 9.54% in 2023, 15.51% in 2024, 13.08% in 2025). LT Debt of €96.0B creates 9.2x Net Debt / NI leverage and interest coverage of 3.98x (EBIT €26.0B vs Interest €6.55B), below the 5.0x fortress threshold. Annual capex exceeds €19B.
